name: BSA Gold Star
engine: 348 or 499 cc air-cooled single, Amal GP carb, magneto
intro: The classic British clubman single. Amal GP carb, magneto and a lot of fakes, so check the numbers.

A: Many 'Gold Stars' are built from other BSAs. Check frame and engine numbers against club records before you pay or restore.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
